title: Cross-dock Shift Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Manage a shift of 30 in our cross-dock hub.

What you'll do
- Coordinate inbound and outbound trucks, dock doors and handlers
- Lead team leaders and assure safety compliance
- Resolve damage and delay cases with carriers

What you bring
- 4+ years in warehouse or transport operations
- Leadership experience and structured working style
- Forklift licence; good German
